description: Get one loss run extraction by id: processing, locked (finished and priced, waiting for the user to approve the cost), completed (unlocked, claims ready) or failed. Includes the claim count, the credits needed to unlock it, the credits charged and the failure reason. Only extractions created through the API are visible, not loss runs uploaded on the LossRunGuru website.

id.description: Extraction id returned by extract_loss_run or list_extractions.
